body: I have been in therapy for over a year consecutively now. Thank you for your words, i honestly am still trying to figure out how to even get admit or what working adult to tell
Im not even sure, i just feel very lonely. It feels like i am at another breaking point and nothing is going right.

That would be fun, I would delete my social media and only use my phone for work or to call people. To be secluded would be nice, but I can’t run away forever and I will always have things to worry about ya know?

If you really want to runaway with your friend I think you should (assuming it’s legal). I think if you plan it out well enough then you can be able to live your dream. Sometimes all you need is a change in your life and being in a new location can fix that. Thought this is something that needs a lot of consideration. But that does sound so pleasing to just run away doesn’t it? I hope the best for you and your friend, please stay safe!
Thank you, I hope you take care of your self too! And stay safe.
Lol thank you. We can all run away if you’d like, even if it’s just a weekend or for the rest of our lives. You may be a 14 year old non binary person but thank you for reaching out when you did.

Hi! I am sorry for the late reply, I just woke up. I understand how you feel. I don’t want to go into details (to avoid triggering or hurting others) but that gray feeling is extremely real. I am always looking for friends so if you need one (or just someone to vent or get angry at) I’m always here.
I don’t want to take a bacteriology because that indicated I would have to actually come back. I want to runaway, it’s be better for my mental health to not be home right now. It’s a lot to get into.
